# The flux register, monitor amounts and conservation budgets {#sec-ch10}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@73c45a7c8c991209924e1137992352c335575062 (UCzhangxi/snapy v3/final)
sources: STRUCTURE.md section 4.1 (the chapter's order) and section 6, chapter 10 (10.1-10.7); the code and tests at the pin

Every face flux of a stage goes through one object, the flux register. This chapter is about that object and what
is read from it. A producer writes a direction's stage total in place or adds, scales and overwrites rows of it
(@sec-ch10-posts). The boundary sets the flux of the faces it owns, and the register books what that removed
(@sec-ch10-prescribed). The removed wall flux of a whole stage, from both the hydro and the scalar register, is
booked in one batch (@sec-ch10-wallbatch). Booked rates and cell posts are folded over the stages into step amounts
(@sec-ch10-amounts). A monitor beside the register counts events, such as faces a floor changed (@sec-ch10-counts).
A rejected attempt zeroes all of that and keeps what a replayed redo needs (@sec-ch10-rollback). After a step is
accepted, the budget output reads the register and writes the budget series (@sec-ch10-budget).

The register is `FluxRegister` ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.hpp FluxRegister >}}) with its `RegisterMonitor`
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.hpp RegisterMonitor >}}). A block has two: the hydro module's, whose totals are the
module's `F1`, `F2`, `F3` buffers ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}), and the scalar module's
({{< code src/scalar/scalar.cpp ScalarImpl::reset >}}). The two share one wall batch
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::reset >}}). Which faces are prescribed, and with what, is the
boundary chapter's (@sec-ch11 in this book, chapter 14 in the V3 outline); this chapter says how the register books
them.

| part | what it holds or does | code | main test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Posts (@sec-ch10-posts) | the stage totals $T_d$ and the kept parts; `add`, `scale`[^rg-a575aa5fdcb6], `replace`, `overwrite_` | `FluxRegister` | `test_flux_register` |
| Prescribed faces (@sec-ch10-prescribed) | the boundary's faces set to their value, the removal booked | `FluxRegister::apply_prescribed` | `test_prescribed_after_sources` |
| Wall batch (@sec-ch10-wallbatch) | one stage's removed wall flux, both registers, booked at the combine | `WallBatch` | `test_flux_register` |
| Amounts (@sec-ch10-amounts) | per-stage rates and posts, folded into step amounts | `RegisterMonitor::fold_` | `test_flux_register` |
| Monitor counts (@sec-ch10-counts) | event counts, minima and retry flags | `RegisterMonitor::count` | `test_flux_register`, `test_fp32_face_floor_counts` |
| Rollback (@sec-ch10-rollback) | a rejected attempt leaves no amount and no count | `FluxRegister::rollback` | `test_flux_register` |
| Budget (@sec-ch10-budget) | totals, change, boundary transfer, counts per interval | `BudgetConsumer` | `test_budget` |
